change: Per-quarter integer repair + purpose reconciliation moved out of write_calibration_report's writer loop into pfe.quarter_publish_counts and solved in the same flat (variant x quarter) fork pool as the interval solves. The writer stays strictly serial (vehicle ids and endpoint draw ordinals accumulate across quarters) and computes any quarter left unfilled inline exactly as before.
why_it_cannot_change_results: The extracted function body is TEXTUALLY identical to the block it replaced (verified mechanically: dedent + the loop-index lookups replaced by the equivalent parameters, no other edit).
It reads only that quarter's own inputs (solution, targets, bounds, rung, purpose mix, structure groups) - no accumulator, no RNG, no shared solver state (plan fact F1).
Counts cross the process boundary through a nonzero mask, which reproduces the original array exactly, dtype included.

fork_safety_note: The counts pool forks from a parent that has not executed the numba IPF kernel (the parent only prepares candidates and forks; the kernel runs in pool workers). A driver that solves in-process and then forks DOES hang - observed while building this proof - which is why the harness exercises the production orchestration rather than an in-process solve.
